subject: general
question: Which of the following is a multipurpose river valley project?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Damodar Valley Project**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Damodar Valley Project** is one of the first multipurpose river valley projects of independent India.
 
• It was established in **1948** under the Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC), modeled after the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) in the United States.
 
• The main focus of this project is on flood control
